page.notes: The „ marks in the left margin are printed quotation marks, one per line, repeated down the page; they are not transcribed as text. Running head: the decorative title is set in heavy type and is not legible enough to copy. The "III." before it is a division number and is left out of the running head. Long s has been normalised to s throughout. The line "rē gratā & æquā" is rendered as printed. Line-end hyphens are kept where printed ("popu-lo", "popu-li", "sedi-tionē", "di-sceptatio" with s normalised to s, "maie-statē"); "dignitate" and "ali quid" are joined without hyphen because no hyphen is printed.
